Description

• Team coordination: Coordinate and supervise teams from various departments to ensure the achievement of set goals.

Profile

• Languages: You have an excellent command of French, English, and Dutch.
• Organizational skills: Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
• Communication skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Strategic marketing: Solid knowledge of strategic marketing concepts.
• Leadership: Ability to lead and supervise teams.
• Adaptability: Able to work in a constantly evolving environment.
• IT skills: Proficient in project management software and common office tools.

Role:

• Design and develop innovative web solutions.
• Implement rigorous automated tests to guarantee the quality, performance and reliability of web applications.
• Participate in the continuous improvement of the user experience.

Profile

• You're a creative, solutions-oriented developer with a passion for teamwork.

The company is an international and renowned expert in business automation through specialization and innovation in its niche market segments. The team consists of about 60 ambitious employees. The company stands for a no-nonsense mentality and flexibility. Do you value an informal work atmosphere, where everyone's opinion is important? Are you passionate about technology? Are you open to a new challenging job? Do you have the right skills and the right drive? Then this is the perfect opportunity for you! 

 

You are responsible for the entire application development process; together with your colleagues you build the perfect solution for the customer. 

To do so, you are assisted by a softwarearchitect with whom you determine the optimal architecture. From there, you take up your responsibility in the development cycle: from development and design to implementation and documentation. 

Thanks to our flat hierarchy your contribution to the result is always visible. You will join a team of other .Net developers in which knowledge sharing and teamwork are basic elements. 

However, independence is also required from time to time. The team is responsible for the complete implementation of projects: from the start-up and configuration to the final delivery.

Furthermore, they work on our newest E-trade products each day. Both products have an annual release program and roadmap in which you are an important link.

 

Your profile

• You bring a solid foundation with a bachelor's degree in IT, or you've carved your path through rich, hands-on experience. 
• Our technical journey includes substantial experience with C#, ASP.NET, and .NET Core, with bonus points for familiarity in Entity Framework, Microservices, Kubernetes and more. Any knowledge of Azure, Fiddler, Git and/or DevOps would be great as well. 
• Your proficiency in both Dutch and English is impeccable, enabling smooth and effective communication
• A sense of humor is always a plus. 
• As a collaborative team player, your open-mindedness and customer focus shine in every project. 
• You are dedicated to continuous learning, always eager to expand your expertise and skills in the ever-evolving IT landscape. 
• Your approach to customer interaction is both seamless and amiable, fostering positive and lasting relationships. 
• 
You are flexible and are open to the opportunity of occasional short trips abroad, adding a global dimension to your role.

As a quality and compliance expert, you will be responsible for ensuring that GxP systems and processes adhere to the applicable regulatory requirements throughout the entire system lifecycle. Therefore, you stay up to date about evolving regulations from authorities such as the EMA and FDA and industry standards like GAMP and ISO. Depending on your role and expertise, you may be asked to provide Quality & Compliance support during audits and inspections, or to join a Sopra Steria validation service team.

As a trusted Computerized System Validation (CSV) Engineer, you play a key role in the validation process of the computerized systems used by our clients in the Life Sciences sector. More specifically, your mission is to ensure the quality and regulatory compliance of GxP systems throughout their entire life cycle and across all GxP areas (GLP, GCP, GMP, GDP, GPvP). Systems in scope can include site-specific lab instruments (e.g. HPLC software) and production equipment (e.g. capsule filling machine), but also globally used web applications, Clinical Trial Management Systems, complex Manufacturing Execution Systems, SAP systems, medical devices, etc…

Your impact as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

The Utilities market is in full transition. At Sopra Steria, we are enthusiastically participating in the digital acceleration within this sector through our Industry and Services market. We aim to grow our advisory agency for Utilities, helping our clients efficiently deal with both current and future challenges in energy transition and sustainable resource management by optimizing processes, improving asset utilization, and enhancing customer experiences.

Your role & responsibilities as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

As a Business Enterprise Architect, you will occupy a key position, crucial to growing our advisory agency within the utilities sector. You will play a significant role in expanding our Industry and Services market, and in executing our strategy to become the preferred digital business partner of our clients by 2026. Your role will be key in architecting digital solutions and strategies that put our clients at the forefront of the energy transition and smart utility management in a rapidly evolving market while driving the growth of our advisory services.

• Design and architect digital transformation initiatives for energy, water, and waste management utilities.
• Lead business framing and solution architecture for key digital themes such as (Transformation consulting, cybersecurity, Data & AI, applications & integrations, cloud & infrastructure).
• Develop enterprise architecture blueprints that align IT direction with business objectives.
• Actively contribute to growing our advisory agency by identifying new opportunities and expanding our client base in the utilities sector.
• 
Create and implement innovative architectural strategies to increase our market share in the Utilities sector, with a focus on digital transformation and sustainability.

 

Your profile as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

• Min 10 years’ experience of IT architecture experience, with 5+ years in digital transformation for the Utilities sector.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a plus.
• Proven track record in digital transformation initiatives, particularly in the energy sector and or water management projects.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital themes specific to utilities (e.g., Smart Grid, Energy Transition, Water Management Systems).
• Professional network in the Utilities sector.
• Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Strategic mindset with the ability to bridge business strategy and technical implementation.
• Passion for innovative technology solutions in utilities, especially in areas of sustainability and resource efficiency.
• Entrepreneurial spirit with a focus on growth and business development in the evolving utilities landscape.
As a member of one of Europe’s largest digital solutions providers, you’ll benefit from extensive career development opportunities, both local and international. At the Sopra Steria Academy, you’ll be part of a dynamic network of 56,000 professionals at all stages of their careers. With a wide array of offices to explore, you can find your ideal location and take the next step in your career. You’ll become a part of a major Tech player in Europe recognised for its consulting, digital services, and software development
